certificates.heading: Certificates

network.label: Network changes

ingress_off.label: Ingress is off

owned.reason: Managed by TierPlan. Switch ingress off to remove it.

owned.serviceBody: TierPlan creates and updates this itself. To remove it, switch ingress off. You can still read its logs and inspect it.
owned.objectBody: TierPlan creates and removes this itself. To remove it, switch ingress off.
